args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following the latest deploy, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Actions taken: (1) Identified the most recent release healthy in production as v2.3.0. (2) Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error left us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1); a retry completed the rollout. (3) Verified post-rollback health: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate back down to 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and any follow-up remediation (e.g., fixing/redeploying v2.3.1) still needs investigation by the owning team.

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (18% error rate) after the latest deploy. The most recent production-healthy release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions**: The first rollback attempt hit an orchestrator error and only completed us-east; a retry successfully rolled out us-west and eu-west.
3. **Verified recovery**: All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now on v2.3.0 — service healthy, error rate back to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)** for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback process (including the partial failure and retry), and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged for root-cause follow-up on v2.3.1.
